items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So I hired him and for two years I had Dinah Washington and Joe Williams for a boy and girl singer.

ctx.x: No, I’m sorry, but you were talking about Joe Williams.

Oh yeah, Joe Williams came into the story. So Joe Glaser came and he told me this friend, Joe Sherman that owned this Sherman Bar & Grill, he told him he was looking for a girl singer for me. So Joe Sherman said, “Well come down and I’ll have my girl in the washroom sing something. You’ll see how she sounds. She sounds pretty good to me.” And that’s what Joe said to Joe Glaser. And I’m trying to think of the trumpet player too that had the band, he had a really hot band, about six or seven pieces. So Joe Glaser…

that. The guy that was standing next to me, because he was a friend of the manager of the Regal Theater where I was playing at, said, “oh, there goes my chance, I wanted to sing with the band.” So I said, “You can sing at the next show, because we’re going to do two matinees.” And I said, “What’s your name?” He said, “My name is Joe Williams.” I said, “Well okay, you can sing.” So I hired him and for two years I had Dinah Washington and Joe Williams for a boy and girl singer.
